title: Choose synthetic SVM data
description: You follow the moons generator and the optional CSV guard.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You define a linear-data generator with two Gaussian groups. It assigns positive-one and negative-one labels and shuffles features and labels together.
You define two noisy curved groups and select DATASET=moons. make_moons creates the supplied number of observations per group, or 800 rows total.

steps.question: Will a successful Colab import trigger CSV upload with the current settings?
steps.answer: The upload guard also requires USE_CSV, which is False. The synthetic data remains selected.

steps.description: You inspect the optional CSV branch, which can replace X and map numeric labels to negative one or positive one when enabled.
You print the selected data shape and positive-label fraction. The recording reports the shape and class balance 0.5.
